chapter: Closing: recent career, family and travel
title: Boat travel versus jet lag
summary: He prefers the romance of ocean liners to jet travel.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So I intend to just hammer it out, stay out here as long as I can. Of course, whenever I get a chance to go back to the continent and do something, I can do it, because the world is a lot different... In the days that I started, you went by boat. This way I can leave you here and have breakfast over in Constantinople somewhere. Isn't that...? It's not the fun that it used to be, because you suffer from jet lag. You cover too much territory too fast.
But at the same time the flying has made things possible that you couldn't do....
Oh, it's made populations shift constantly and rapidly.
If you want to play an engagement in France for ten weeks, you've got to spend... In those days you were traveling two weeks!

Well, you had time to really enjoy it physically, too. But now, for you to take two weeks in Paris, and then you've got two more weeks in Los Angeles.... Hey! I mean, before you realize where you are, it takes time. And then after that, you pack up and you go to Vancouver or Toronto, and then back down to Argentina or somewhere... That's too much.. It's very unnatural, you know.

You can't take that. You don't have the (?) to cover that much territory. But in the old days, it was romantic to take a boat to England on say Cunard Line, or France somewhere, you know, Scandinavia, and in the interim you would meet people, you'd make deals...
